name: Sunwarmed Furline mounts its rider (#4898)
contract: Issue #4898: the Sunwarmed Furline collection mount (wrapper spell 9931327, taught by item 1777060) did not
summon. #7150 bound the wrapper to spell_ascension_local_mount, which picks the child mount by Riding skill
(AscensionCollectibleSpellData row 9931327: creature 80403, Ground60 530422). Expected for a level 60 rider
with Riding 75 in Stormwind: the cast is not refused, the rider gets the Ground60 child aura 530422 and sits on
display 99008 (creature 80403, catmount.m2); dismounting clears the display.

steps.label: CONTROL: the rider is not mounted
the wrapper applies the Ground60 child mount
the rider sits on the Sunwarmed Furline
